why: Macworld has three pages that answer this directly (AceFast review, Mophie review, 4-in-1 roundup), and WIRED tested stations and covers the Mophie 4-in-1. That is a lot of reviewer weight, but it all comes from one author, and each page is a single review or a MagSafe/3-in-1 roundup. No dedicated head-to-head 4-in-1 comparison exists. The rest of the results are spam, 3-in-1 listicles and a store page. A focused page could get in but would compete with Macworld.
